failureReason.description: Required when outcome is FAILED and forbidden when DELIVERED or COLLECTED; free text (trimmed, no control characters), the model defines no vocabulary.

outcomeDetail.description: Optional category of the attempt, reported by the driver client. FAILED accepts NOT_HOME, ACCESS_PROBLEM and OTHER; DELIVERED accepts SAFE_PLACE_USED; any other pairing is 422 validation-failed. Omitted means not reported (a legacy client), which is not the same as OTHER. It never replaces failureReason.
outcomeDetail.title: OutcomeDetail
